full_page.content:
Page 28 Feb. 14 Michael Czajka - 58 - never sick before now bleeding ulcers of sto- mach. Yesterday was given up as hopeless; Enrolled anually and promise is made of perpet. To-night quite improved and enrolled perpt.
Bridget Hebron - 60 - fits like Epyleptic ... follow by fearful stomach pains for several years
Ann Kunter - 15 - not well, out of school and almost
Josephine Lamon - 40 - lansing - away from family for four yrs .... now prides herself on being out of the Church - sisters here heart broken Mrs. Mary Churella - 31 - kidney and gall-stone trouble ...
Mrs. Anna Genev. Quell - 48 - double cataracts ... sometime discouraged - 6 in family ... only husband working
Mrs. Louse Ryckbush - 38 - abcessed breast supposed to be cancerous absolutely cured - no scar left - Thank God
Robert Adamson - 9 - non Cath. - Spinal
Page 29 Feb. Mrs. Esther Reed - 80 - diabetis, brites etc. near (Richmond) St. Clair Hospital wants to be Cathlic - out of Church over 60 year.
Clara Gesell 5025 Devonshire - 40 - lost her mind about two yrs. ago - in Marywood Hospital; Husband started to read the autobiography of the B1. V. Mary ..... She is home now and very promising. Mind cleared up.
Mrs. Stella Schemanski - 55 - fell off a lader some months ago and in- jured her knee-caps etc is having trouble with her back. Her daughter also on some accasion was seriously hurt - ask -
20 Mrs. Cath. Harrison - 55 - breast-cancer fears operation necessary ...
21 Lea Sprier & Husband & Son went to Belg'm last year .... He seems to have changed attitude since returning.
John Burns - 60 - had operation on stomach three weeks ago ... Very lit- tle improvement noticed if any
